I am a physicist working at the intersection of **medical physics and machine learning**. I am currently a master's student at the 7 Tesla MRI group at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ), following earlier work on electron track reconstruction for the LHCb Collaboration.

## Current work

- **7 Tesla MRI:** Master's research in Medical Physics in Radiology at DKFZ.
- **ParquetAnnotations:** A Linux-first application for visualising ECG and pulse data with annotation markers.
- **Parquet Viewer:** A Linux-first application for browsing and filtering Apache Parquet files.

## Selected outputs

- [Bachelor's thesis: Electron Track Reconstruction Studies and Improvement for LHCb's Real-Time Analysis Trigger](https://repository.cern/records/tsgg5-mnd54)
- [ParquetAnnotations](projects/parquet-annotations.qmd) and [Parquet Viewer](projects/parquet-viewer.qmd)
- [The Physics of Nuclear Spin Systems](publications/index.qmd#the-physics-of-nuclear-spin-systems)
